title: Chen Rui: AI Will Improve the Efficiency of High-Quality Content Supply, Bilibili Is Expected to Become a Beneficiary Platform in the AI Era
excerpt: Bilibili announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results on November 24. As of September 30, the company's total revenue for the third quarter reached RMB 8.
content_html:
Bilibili announced its third-quarter 2026 financial results on November 24. As of September 30, the company's total revenue for the third quarter reached RMB 8.32 billion, up 8% year over year. Community engagement continued to rise: average daily active users (DAU) reached 124 million, average monthly active users (MAU) increased to 394 million, and average daily time spent surpassed two hours for the first time, reaching 121 minutes. All three core community metrics hit record highs.

On the earnings call, Chen Rui, Chairman and CEO of Bilibili, said that the community is Bilibili's most important competitive moat and is jointly built by users, UP creators, and the platform. Users' continued demand for high-quality content forms the foundation of the community; UP creators meet that demand through their work; users drive creators' growth through feedback and incentives; and the platform connects the two sides and builds trust and a sense of belonging.

Speaking about competition in short-form content, Chen Rui said that short-form content focuses on continuously capturing users' attention, while Bilibili pays more attention to the impact of high-quality content on users' minds and the sense of fulfillment it brings, which has created a differentiated user base.

Regarding the industry changes brought by AI, Chen Rui said Bilibili is expected to be one of the major beneficiaries in the AI era. In the past, the core bottleneck in producing high-quality content was supply. AI technology can improve content creation efficiency and also help accelerate the matching of high-quality content with target users. He believes that users' demand for high-quality content will persist over the long term, and as younger users grow up and their aesthetic standards improve, Bilibili's user base is still expected to continue expanding.
